resources.string: Stop and send Companion diagnostic log
Companion logging started. Logs may contain callsigns, locations and messages. Use Send when finished.

ATAK Callsign: %1$s (%2$s)
Bluetooth Address: %3$s
Bluetooth Strength: %4$s
WearTAK Callsign: %5$s
WearTAK Product Name: %6$s
Samsung Wearable use disabled; checking for a compatible already bonded watch…

This plugin relays CoT between WearTAK watches and ATAK EUDs using the existing direct BLE transport for Samsung/Wear OS watches and an optional Garmin Connect IQ transport via Garmin Connect Mobile. It also allows WearTAK settings to be configured via ATAK EUD.
